<a id="architecture"></a>

## Architecture

Doctrine: .agents/skills/pij-team/TENETS.md. Rust. u1 lives in crates/cli/src/main.rs (clap verbs: send/inbox/state/report… — find every `seat: Option<String>` / --from arg) + a new small module crates/cli/src/identity.rs: `resolve_acting_seat(env, pane, client) -> Result<SeatId, NamedRefusal>`. Send every available identity input to POST /v1/whoami: the daemon's one authority treats an observable pane as authoritative, accepts PIJ_SESSION_ID only when no pane contradicts it, and refuses disagreement by name. Do NOT re-implement the daemon's ladder: the shim already uses crates/daemon/src/http/identity.rs resolve_seat. Body sources: --body, --body-file <path>, --body-file - (stdin), read literally and never through shell evaluation (clap `allow_hyphen_values` on --body). msg-id minting: uuid crate v7 (or ulid) — check Cargo.lock for what is already present, add nothing new if avoidable. u2: crates/daemon/src/pointer/mod.rs render_pointer text (`run: pij inbox` → `run: pij inbox check`) + adopt response text in crates/daemon/src/http/identity.rs. Ruling: weasel 2026-09-02 — every pane-bound harness, including omp/pi, gets pane-derived identity guidance; export advice is paneless-only.
